unter: This installation is currently measuring how much your device can handle. It isn’t a library: after the test you copy the result and shut the container down.
stufe.extrem: extreme – load limit at 500,000 or 1 million folders
schritt.pruefen: Checking whether this is a test installation
schritt.einrichten: Setting up Ablago for testing (accounts, examples, rules)
schritt.hintergrund: Waiting until Ablago has finished its background work
schritt.aufraeumen: Undoing what was changed by saving during the measurement
fertig.verfehlt: Your device misses one of the project’s limits – that isn’t a fault of your installation. That’s exactly when your report helps.
abbruch: The load test was cancelled and created nothing.
fehler.protokoll: Details are in the container’s log.
ohne-datei_one: One document without a file – is /data mounted as a volume?
ohne-datei_other: Documents without a file: {zahl} – is /data mounted as a volume?
ohne-datei.text: The database is still there, but the files are missing. Downloads, previews and exports of these documents fail, so the measurement isn’t comparable. Without volumes, recreate both containers before every run (docker compose down, then up -d).
geraet.beispiel: e.g. UGREEN DXP4800 Plus, 16 GB RAM
geraet.hinweis: Model and specification – no names, addresses or computer names. The text appears in the result that you publish.
speicher.hinweis.erkannt: Detected automatically: {art}. If that’s wrong, choose the right type.
speicher.hinweis.offen: Couldn’t be detected in the container – choose what you know.
automatisch: The test fills in CPU, cores and memory by itself.
ergebnis.text: Without names and addresses – only what you write in the device field above. Copy the block unchanged into the form or as a comment on the collective issue.
ergebnis.warten: The result appears here as soon as the test is finished.
kopieren.geht-nicht: Copying doesn’t work in this browser – select the text and copy it yourself.
datei: Also saved in the container under {datei} and in its logs.
beenden: End test and shut down the container
beenden.frage.laeuft: The test is still running and will be cancelled. Afterwards everything is gone.
beenden.frage.fertig: The container shuts down; the page stops responding afterwards.
beendet.text: If started with “--rm”, the container is removed automatically afterwards. Otherwise you can delete it in your NAS’s Docker interface, and the image too if needed.
uebersicht: DMS_LASTTEST is set, but the load test doesn’t start here:
uebersicht.text: Ablago keeps running normally. Remove the variable from the Compose file – the load test only exists in a separate test installation.
beenden.ungesichert: You haven’t copied or downloaded the result yet. When the container shuts down it is gone if the container runs without a data folder.
danke: Thank you for taking part in the measurement!
danke.text: The test container is now shutting down. You can close this page.
danke.teilen: If you haven’t yet: share your result in the
live.text: Values from the running measurement, as of {zeit} – the test polls them every 2 seconds anyway.
live.text.vorbereitung: Load during preparation, as of {zeit} – the same measurement the test takes every 2 seconds. Run and p95 follow with the first measurement.
live.warteschlange.wert: up to {wartend} waiting queries · {belegt} of {von} connections in use
live.gruppen.nicht: Not available – can only be measured on Linux.
live.gruppen.text: Like top inside the container, by group: 100 % is one full core. Memory as RSS – shared memory counts more than once.
live.postgres-extern: in its own container – cannot be measured
live.meldungen.keine: No warnings or errors in the log so far.
